title: Global Equity Valuations Deep Dive Analysis
summary: Global valuations meet fiscal and liquidity constraints.
coverage_note: All blocks 0-127 and 22 image labels read. Coverage includes Treasury issuance, credit-cycle interpretation, real equity horizon, crypto access and supply, international valuation caveats, capital-flow catalysts, Brazil and defensive allocations. Charts were not visually inspected; no portfolio performance is inferred.

claims.reason: A flat constructed liquidity series does not establish policymaker intent. A reaction function or documentary evidence would be needed to distinguish management from coincident balance-sheet flows.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

claims.reason: The official release confirms slower increases in long-tenor auctions relative to shorter coupons, but bills were scheduled for modest December reductions. Relative issuance composition must be distinguished from an absolute increase or inability to sell duration.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

evidence.title: November 2023 refunding
evidence.finding: Treasury increased coupon auctions, with a more moderate increase in longer tenors. Bills would remain at current auction sizes until late November, then decline modestly. This confirms a relative maturity adjustment, not abandonment of long-bond issuance.

claims.reason: A judgment that one announcement mattered more than another has no event-study window or market variable. One market reaction cannot demonstrate subordination of monetary policy to financing.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

claims.reason: Long-tenor adjustments and liquidity-support buybacks are observable. They do not by themselves establish deficient aggregate demand or that deficits and QT alone caused bank stress; rate volatility and dealer capacity also matter.

evidence.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
evidence.finding: The Desk announced $40 billion of initial bill purchases starting December 12, to maintain ample reserves. This is not itself evidence of deficit monetization as the causal motive.

claims.reason: Large deficits can support nominal demand, but the counterfactual depends on slack, tax financing, spending composition and monetary response. Neither a crisis threshold nor an inflation coefficient is specified.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

claims.reason: At a uniform 5% effective rate, $34 tn times 0.05 equals $1.7 tn. This is a conditional gross-interest calculation, not a dated net-budget-interest forecast; debt composition, intragovernmental holdings and refinancing speed matter.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

assumptions: Uniform effective rate of 5% after full refinancing
proof.derivation: Annual gross interest = debt times rate = $34 tn * 0.05 = $1.7 tn.

claims.reason: Rate cuts can lower future refinancing costs while weaker receipts widen deficits. The net balance and timing require a fiscal model; neither channel guarantees overall relief.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

claims.reason: This is a possible response to easing market yields, without a speech, policy threshold or deadline. It is not a firm additional-hike prediction.

claims.reason: The S&P 500 regained its late-2021 CPI-adjusted peak by June 2024. evidence.title: Real S&P peak comparison
evidence.finding: Latest-vintage daily SP 500 divided by same-month CPIAUCSL: late 2021 maximum at December 29, 4793.06/CPI 280.845. First post-October 29 2023 exceedance June 5 2024, 5354.03/CPI 313.044. Price index excludes dividends; monthly deflator is ex-post, not a tradable signal. evidence.title: Broad-market VTI real-price comparison
evidence.publisher: Yahoo Finance and BLS via FRED
evidence.finding: Unadjusted daily VTI close divided by latest-vintage same-month CPIAUCSL: 2021 maximum November 16, $242.789993 / CPI 278.919 = 0.870467746. First postpublication exceedance July 10, 2024, $275.059998 / CPI 313.569 = 0.877191296. Dividend exclusion and ex-post monthly deflator match price-level analysis, not an executable strategy. VTI is a broad-market proxy rather than Wilshire.

claims.reason: The caveat about unusual cycles is appropriate. A raw 0.5-point rise is not the Sahm rule, and subsequent Fed research documents false positives, including 2003; the universal historical formulation is overstrong.

International holdings appreciated but lagged the US in the evaluator window, and Itau has not completed its five-year horizon.
